name: Policy Management
description: Full policy lifecycle: quote, bind, issue, endorse, renew, cancel. Supports multi-criteria search (Policy Number, Insured Name, SSN/TIN, Policy Type, Address, Loss Date), policy detail view with vehicle/coverage/location details, WCAG-compliant UI, and SSN/TIN masking.

name: Claim Processing
description: End-to-end claim lifecycle from FNOL through investigation, adjustment, settlement, denial, and close. Includes claim search, claim history per policy, claim reopening, subrogation referral, injury incident details, ICD/CPT coding, and carrier involvement tracking.

name: Underwriting Engine
description: Risk assessment and premium calculation using rating factors (territory, risk, coverage), eligibility checking, automated underwriting thresholds, and re-rating on endorsements. Supports multi-policy and claims-free discounts.

name: Coverage Management
description: Coverage types (LIABILITY, COLLISION, COMPREHENSIVE, MEDICAL_PAYMENTS, UNINSURED_MOTORIST, PROPERTY_DAMAGE, BODILY_INJURY, UMBRELLA), per-coverage limits and deductibles, aggregate limit enforcement, and coverage add/remove via endorsement.

name: Insured Management
description: Individual and organization insured profiles with SSN/TIN encryption and masking, contact and address information, and linkage to policies and claims.

name: Payments & Disbursements
description: Full payment lifecycle (create, void, reverse, reissue) across methods: ACH, Wire, Credit/Debit Card, Stripe Connect, Global Payouts. Supports positive/negative/zero amounts, joint payees, eroding/non-eroding designation, reserve allocation, tax withholding, 1099 reporting, document attachment, and idempotent processing.

name: Payee Onboarding & KYC
description: Secure onboarding of vendors, claimants, attorneys, and medical providers with KYC identity verification, payment method verification, onboarding status tracking (PENDING, VERIFIED, REJECTED, SUSPENDED), and PCI-DSS compliant banking data encryption.

name: Reserve Management
description: Multiple reserve lines per claim (Medical, Indemnity, Expense, Legal), reserve creation and adjustment with reason codes, real-time balance tracking, allocation of payments across reserve lines, and eroding/non-eroding reserve designation.

name: Claim-Level Policy Data Override
description: Ability to add or edit policy information at the claim level when the associated policy is unverified. Changes stored separately without overwriting original policy data; visual indicator shown; all changes audit-logged.

name: Policy Endorsement
description: Mid-term policy modifications (add/remove coverage, change limits/deductibles, add/remove vehicles, address changes) with automatic premium re-rating, endorsement number generation (END-YYYY-NNNNNN), and endorsement history on policy record.

name: EDI/EOB Medical Payments
description: EDI 837 ingestion for medical claim submissions, EDI 835 remittance advice generation, CPT/ICD code mapping and validation, bill review vendor integration, EOB output generation, and adjustment reason code capture.

name: Estimate Import (Xactimate/XactAnalysis)
description: Automated creation of payable line items from property damage estimates imported from Xactimate/XactAnalysis. Line-item review/approval workflow before payment creation; coverage limit validation.

name: Negotiation & Settlement Management
description: Negotiation workflow tracking (opening demand, counter-offers, final settlement), coverage opinion request management, settlement plan creation with structured payment schedules, and signed agreement status tracking.

name: Payment Routing Rules
description: Configuration of payment routing rules based on payee type, payment type, and business rules. Admin-configurable without code changes, applied automatically during payment creation.

name: Subrogation Management
description: Referral of settled/closed claims to subrogation team, capture of responsible third-party and other carrier information (carrier name, policy number, coverage details), recovery amount tracking, and integration across claim functions and payments.

name: Audit Trail
description: Immutable, comprehensive audit log for all user actions across Policy, Claims, and Payments modules. Captures user_id, action_type, entity_type, entity_id, timestamp, before/after state (JSON). Retained 7 years. Searchable by authorized compliance roles.

name: Role-Based Access Control
description: Enforcement of RBAC across all modules with roles: Agent, Underwriter, Claims Adjuster, Claims Manager, Payment Processor, Admin. Per-role permissions for read/write/approve actions. MFA for payment-enabled roles.

name: Insurance Reporting
description: Annual premium reports and claims reports for regulatory filing, loss ratio calculations, 1099 tax reporting for reportable payees, and payment/reserve financial reports for General Ledger reconciliation.
